scope.research_stage: prediction only; no options trading strategy or P&L selection
scope.result_row_grain: exactly one terminal row for each registered config_id × outer fold_id, including blocked and failed rows

outer_fold_rules.boundaries: Use the eight inclusive date windows in the pinned preregistration without changing dates.
outer_fold_rules.session_indices: Map each label's decision and endpoint dates to the label-specific eligible official exchange-session index defined by the pinned calendar.
outer_fold_rules.train_maturity: A training row's target endpoint session index must be strictly less than the outer validation start index.
outer_fold_rules.purge: Also require decision_session_index < validation_start_session_index - purge_exchange_sessions from the frozen label manifest; do not override the horizon-specific value.
outer_fold_rules.validation_scoring: Score only rows whose decision session is at least embargo_exchange_sessions after validation start, is before validation end-exclusive, and whose target endpoint session index lies inside [validation_start, validation_end_exclusive).
outer_fold_rules.endpoint_after_fold: Record and exclude target endpoints outside the same validation fold; do not score cross-fold target endpoints.
outer_fold_rules.preflight_blocks: A frozen BLOCKED_DATA label/fold cell remains blocked only for that exact cell; do not propagate positional F01 blocks to later folds.

inner_fold_rules.session_universe: All eligible official exchange sessions strictly before the current outer validation start, not a random sample and not a row-count quantile.
inner_fold_rules.quantile_method: Use integer floor for deterministic session-index cutpoints: floor(0.40*n), floor(0.60*n), floor(0.80*n), n.
inner_fold_rules.train: For each inner fold, train only on sessions before its validation start and apply the same target-maturity and label-specific purge rules as the outer fold.
inner_fold_rules.validation: Apply the frozen label-specific embargo; target endpoints must stay inside the same inner validation interval.
inner_fold_rules.failure: If any inner fold fails frozen row/class support, block the config/outer-fold before estimator fitting; do not alter intervals or substitute a random split.

support_rules.source: Use role-specific per-label minima already frozen in PREDICTION_PREREGISTRATION_R3_2026-10-13.json.
support_rules.validation_classes: Count UP and DOWN support independently; no class support may be borrowed across labels or folds.
support_rules.feature_history: Incomplete lookback history is excluded and counted; no interpolation or forward-fill.
support_rules.label_support: Use the existing 1% target-pair missingness gate and exact preflight label/fold disposition.

result_rows.blocked_metrics: All predictive metrics, p-values and confidence-interval fields must be null for BLOCKED_DATA, BLOCKED_GATE and FAILED_TECHNICAL rows.
result_rows.error_logging: Persist config_id, method_id, label_id, fold_id, execution step, exception type and traceback SHA-256 for technical failures. Never silently retry with altered inputs.
result_rows.restartability: Persist row-level terminal state atomically; resume only unterminal config/fold pairs against the same source and code hashes.
result_rows.log_loss_improvement: baseline_log_loss minus candidate_log_loss, computed on exactly the same evaluation rows.
result_rows.result_completeness: Validate uniqueness and complete 40,000 × 8 config/fold coverage before freezing the full bundle. Partial runs are explicitly incomplete and never treated as final results.

statistical_analysis.inference: Use the frozen preregistered paired session-block bootstrap and Benjamini–Yekutieli adjustment exactly as recorded in the preregistration.
statistical_analysis.selection: No metric-based family/model selection until the complete result bundle is frozen and hashes are recorded.
statistical_analysis.forbidden: No trading P&L, options entry/exit logic, cost model or post-hoc threshold optimization in this prediction-only gate.
